rationale: This is a near-perfect fit for the DNA. The mechanism (a reCAPTCHA image challenge that only ever reshuffles) is the argument: the verify-loop enacts the unwinnable authentication of art, so concept and execution collapse into one object (P1). The reCAPTCHA readymade is a fresh web-native found object (P2), and the Suprematist generator sits cleanly on the chance/order axis (P5). It double-codes perfectly (P7): a casual viewer gets the gag, a literate viewer gets Malevich, the reverse-Turing test, and the market critique (P6). It explicitly answers But is it art? (2025) as its anti-YES, and the footer line interrogates reCAPTCHA's hidden human-computation purpose rather than merely using it (P10). Build is minimal (P3), client-side only, CC BY-SA, no trackers (P8), dry and witty (P9).
